lines.trans: Before graduation, I felt nothing mattered more than chasing my own dream.
After getting to know Mr Chun Yuqiao, I grew even more certain I made the right choice.
Far from disappointing me or changing my mind, it convinced me Mr Chun Yuqiao is right.
I feel lucky; from here on out I will follow Mr Chun Yuqiao's lead and trust him.
Because he is the one who gives me drive and keeps me moving forward.
Everything about Lonely Island is great except the title feels too heavy—we should rename it.
Alright, let us brainstorm together—first, the title needs a sense of motion.
The core idea Mr Chun Yuqiao designed is breaking free from an isolated island.
I think the verb escape feels playful like a game and carries real urgency.
Let us polish it a touch further—how about calling it Charming Voyage?
